notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Newly Added Abilities

 Torpedo Cannonballs
Launch gunpowder powered cannonballs towards enemy ships and attack them from below

 Air Strike
Fire a barrage of cannons into the sky to wreck multiple enemies

 Mace
A rotating mace attached to your ship to wreck other ships

Newly Added Power Ups

 Piercing Cannonballs
Cannonballs that can pierce through enemies without losing momentum, allowing you to strike multiple ships at once

 Ramming
Sink enemy ships by ramming your armored ship through them


Smaller Updates

 Pink Gem now pulls in everything, not only XP and loot

Cheers,
Aremji Games

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Ahoy Pirates!

A bunch of small updates have been implemented into the Ocean Survivors Demo!



 Enemy cannonballs are now color coded red for better visibility
 Sky Pirate hit detection has been reworked to be more efficient in sinking ships
 Various VFX have been added to increase visibility
 Trireme (charging enemy) has more health - Balancing


Cheers,
Aremji Games
